Adjust after trying the nut: +0.05 if too tight, -0.05 if loose."},"nut_recess":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"nut sits this far below the knob face, so it is fully inside"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"asked","note":"about 30 mm across, requested"},"knob_h":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_n":{"value":6,"kind":"design","source":"design","unit":"count"},"scallop_r":{"value":4.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"grip scallop radius"},"lead_in":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"mouth chamfer on the pocket flats"},"coupon_d":{"value":18,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_h":{"value":8,"kind":"design","source":"design"}}, "parts": [{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"Knob's top face (the face away from the nut pocket) flat on the bed; pocket opens upward, so no supports or bridges are needed.","use_orientation":"Pocket faces down toward the work, towards the bolt; the knob is turned by its scalloped rim.","code":"import math
def build(p):
    H = p.knob_h
    af = p.nut_af + p.pocket_fit
    circ = af / math.cos(math.radians(30))
    depth = p.nut_h + p.nut_recess
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(H).faces('<Z').chamfer(1.0)
    for i in range(int(p.scallop_n)):
        a = 2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_n
        R = p.knob_d/2 + p.scallop_r - 3.0
        cut = cq.Workplane('XY').center(R*math.cos(a), R*math.sin(a)).circle(p.scallop_r).extrude(H)
        body = body.cut(cut)
    pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-depth).polygon(6, circ).extrude(depth)
    body = body.cut(pocket)
    ap = af/2
    cone = cq.Workplane('XY').add(cq.Solid.makeCone(ap, ap+p.lead_in, p.lead_in, pnt=cq.Vector(0,0,H-p.lead_in), dir=cq.Vector(0,0,1)))
    body = body.cut(cone)
    hole = cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clear)/2).extrude(H)
    body = body.cut(hole)
    return body

def build(p):

    pocket = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=H-depth).polygon(6, circ).extrude(depth)
    body = body.cut(pocket)

    cone = cq.Workplane('XY').add(cq.Solid.makeCone(ap, ap+p.lead_in, p.lead_in, pnt=cq.Vector(0,0,H-p.lead_in), dir=cq.Vector(0,0,1)))
